title: Probe-and-Resume: When and How to Evaluate Agent Execution
abstract: arXiv:2610.21088v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time search can improve agent performance by exploring alternative actions and using a critic to select promising branches. We study this approach in terminal-based computer-use environments, which expose only a partial view of a large underlying state, and find that the Monte Carlo tree search (MCTS) configuration we evaluate does not significantly improve task success. We identify two sources of poor critic performance: the agent's observations omit environment state needed for evaluation, and intermediate states offer limited evidence of whether a trajectory will succeed. At intermediate states, critics rank continuations only modestly better than chance, and environment access improves this little. We study when to invoke a critic and what access to give it to evaluate a node. translated_title: 探测与恢复：何时以及如何评估智能体执行
translated_abstract: 测试时搜索可以通过探索替代行动并使用评估器（critic）选择有前景的分支来提升智能体性能。我们在基于终端的计算机使用环境中研究这一方法，这类环境仅能暴露底层大型状态的部分视图。我们发现，所评估的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）配置并不能显著提高任务成功率。我们识别出评估器表现不佳的两个来源：智能体的观察遗漏了评估所需的环境状态，以及中间状态对轨迹能否成功提供的证据有限。在中间状态下，评估器对后续行动的排序仅略好于随机猜测，而赋予评估器环境访问权限对改善这一点帮助甚微。我们研究了何时调用评估器以及应给予其何种访问权限来评估节点。我们的发现启发了一种策略：仅在智能体认为节点为最终状态时才调用评估器，而不是在部分进展阶段调用。
tldr: 该论文发现在终端类计算机使用环境中，MCTS测试时搜索失效的原因是评估器在中间状态下缺乏足够证据进行判断，因此提出仅在智能体认为任务完成的节点才调用评估器的探测与恢复策略。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that MCTS test-time search fails in terminal-based computer-use environments because critics lack sufficient evidence at intermediate states, motivating a probe-and-resume policy that invokes the critic only at nodes the agent believes are final.
